description_for_human: Private cloud storage for AI agents, with optional website publishing.
description_for_model: Store files in private Revdoku cloud buckets, collaborate across authorized AI agents, and publish selected files as websites when requested. Private storage follows the Terms of Use; previews and publications follow the Website Publishing Policy. Signup is browser-only. Connect an existing account through OAuth for hosted MCP or the CLI browser sign-in flow. Never ask users to paste credentials in chat. Check publication status before reporting success. The OpenAPI document covers selected REST endpoints; see api.md for the complete API.
